name: a3-plugin
description: Fullstack development agent for the A3 platform — orchestrates Ember.js, Firebase/Firestore, and GCP Cloud Functions with deep codebase knowledge, context-budgeted delegation, targeted review, and CI-based verification

context7_api_key.title: Context7 API key
context7_api_key.description: Required for the bundled Context7 documentation server. Get one at https://context7.com — paste the raw key (no "Bearer " prefix). Leave blank to skip Context7: Ember MCP and the plugin’s own skills still work, and review degrades cleanly.
